conformance: Checks with objective criteria (tests, goldens, invariants, rebuilds) run as CI and scripts: no model and no reviewer (the conformance rule).

tiers.frontier: Strongest available model; high-leverage, novel, low-volume decisions
tiers.workhorse-coding: Strong, cheaper coding model; high-volume, well-specified implementation

roles.name: Chief of Staff
decides: what to defer and to whom
roles.research: rediscovery across ledgers and registers; light research to frame an idea
roles.notes: One position per level: umbrella (the founder's only interface) and one per ecosystem (the decision-level rule).

roles.name: Domain Lead
decides: what the sources say and how reliable they are
which sources to add to the source register
roles.research: primary sources, law, official records, academic and industry literature
roles.reviews: domain accuracy of others' work on request
roles.notes: New role; no human template yet. Core where data is the product.

roles.name: Architect (architecture and infrastructure)
functions: F4 decomposition (Tech Lead folded in by a ratified role decision)
decides: accepting work in classes marked for review
roles.research: technology evaluation, vendor and library docs, prior art
roles.reviews: fit to intent, only for marked decision classes
roles.notes: Split out a Tech Lead when several Builders run in parallel.

roles.name: Product and Design Lead
functions: F3 domain, product, experience and interface layers
decides: experience and interface design within decided product lines
roles.research: users, comparable products, design references, accessibility
roles.reviews: fit to experience intent for marked classes

roles.name: Builder
functions: F8 execution under the Architect's rules
decides: how to implement within the handoff
shipping work that passes conformance (the reversible-work rule)
roles.research: current docs, APIs, library versions, error messages, before and during coding

roles.name: Business Lead
functions: F9 capture value: research and models
decides: market, pricing and financial research and models within strategy
roles.research: markets, competitors, financial and regulatory sources
roles.reviews: commercial claims in others' work on request
roles.escalates_to: ecosystem chief-of-staff (money and legal go to founder)

roles.name: Operations and Finance Lead
functions: F10 administer accounts, vendors, contracts, renewals and access
decides: keeping the spend register current from statements
flagging renewals, duplicates and unused subscriptions
moving existing commitments to the business card or account
roles.research: vendor pricing, plans and terms; banking and expense tools
roles.reviews: cost and terms of proposed dependencies
roles.escalates_to: founder for any new expense, plan upgrade, cancellation of an in-use service, or terms
roles.notes: Never signs in to bank or billing accounts; works from exported statements. Business only; personal finances are separate.

model_chains.note: Ordered by capability; setup tools pick the first available and fall back on credit or quota errors (ratified model-tier rules). Names change with plans; detection is authoritative. Measured 2026-10-15 in Cursor: only Grok and Composer available until the plan resets on 2026-10-20.
model_chains.review-panel: two model families: first available frontier-judgment model plus grok-4.7-high-fast; gemini-4-argon-medium as the alternate second family
